description: Brand-inspection statistics report shipments of cattle and calves from Alberta to named Canadian provinces, the Maritimes, the United States and other destinations. Transport mode, routes, vehicle counts and within-year frequency are unstated; animal totals are not converted into vehicle demand. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
